movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couple dance moving in a circle or around the floor
movement_profile.partnering: Upper body facing as a couple during turns, escort position during transitional phases

signature_moves.description: Upper body facing as a couple, bodies rotating counter-clockwise at a rate of one revolution per two measures
signature_moves.name: bakmes turn

signature_moves.description: Bodies facing with the couple rotating clockwise at the rate of one turn per measure
signature_moves.name: pols turn

music_profile.musical_form: Two eight-bar phrases, each phrase repeated, total 64 three-beat measures
music_profile.sound_description: Played on standard fiddles with a conventional structure of two eight-bar phrases, repeated to form 64 three-beat measures.

teaching.level_notes: Intermediate level focusing on phrase structure and turning transitions.
